facts.text: Caroline created a stained glass window for a local church to illustrate the theme of personal and collective growth through change.

evidence.quote: It was made for a local church and shows time changing our lives. I made it to show my own journey as a transgender woman and how we should accept growth and change.

facts.text: Caroline's stained glass window is described as a symbol of togetherness and celebrating differences to bring people closer.

evidence.quote: It's a symbol of togetherness, to celebrate differences and be that much closer.

facts.text: Caroline expressed a desire to create another artwork similar to the stained glass window in the future.

evidence.quote: I'd love to make something like this next!

facts.text: Caroline mentioned that she was inspired by a rainbow sidewalk she encountered during a walk in her neighborhood for Pride Month.

evidence.quote: I was out walking in my neighborhood when I came across this cool rainbow sidewalk for Pride Month. It was so vibrant and welcoming, I had to take a picture!
